_comment: Every user-facing string in comfy-bomi. Add a language by adding its key to each entry; select it with "language" in config.json.

nodes.background.description.en: Generate new backgrounds for a product image with the Bomi enterprise API.
nodes.background.description.zh: 使用 Bomi 企业 API 为商品图生成新背景。

nodes.ai_suite.description.en: Generate model shots and background scenes in one call. Returns two image batches.
nodes.ai_suite.description.zh: 一次调用同时生成模特图与背景图，返回两组图片。

nodes.ecommerce_white_background.descrip.en: Remove the background and produce an e-commerce white-background image.
nodes.ecommerce_white_background.descrip.zh: 去除背景并生成电商白底图。

nodes.wear_ring_plus.description.en: Render a hand naturally wearing the ring from the input image.
nodes.wear_ring_plus.description.zh: 生成手部自然佩戴输入戒指的效果图。

inputs.image.tooltip.en: Input image. Uploaded as PNG, or JPEG if config.json says so; the API accepts only PNG and JPEG, up to 20 MB per image. An oversized PNG is re-encoded as JPEG automatically. If a batch is connected, only the first image is used.
inputs.image.tooltip.zh: 输入图片。默认以 PNG 上传（可在 config.json 中改为 JPEG）；接口仅支持 PNG 与 JPEG，单张不超过 20 MB。超出大小的 PNG 会自动改用 JPEG 重新编码。若连接的是图片批次，仅使用第一张。

inputs.api_key.tooltip.en: Overrides enterpriseApiKey from config.json when non-empty. WARNING: anything typed here is saved into exported workflow JSON and into output PNG metadata. Prefer config.json or the BOMI_ENTERPRISE_API_KEY environment variable.
inputs.api_key.tooltip.zh: 填写后将覆盖 config.json 中的 enterpriseApiKey。注意：此处填写的内容会被保存到导出的工作流 JSON 与输出图片的元数据中。建议使用 config.json 或 BOMI_ENTERPRISE_API_KEY 环境变量。

inputs.background_style_id.tooltip.en: Which background style to generate. Fetched from your Bomi account. An empty list means the pack could not reach the API: set enterpriseApiKey in config.json, then refresh the browser.
inputs.background_style_id.tooltip.zh: 选择要生成的背景风格。列表来自你的 Bomi 账号。若为空说明未能访问接口：请在 config.json 中填写 enterpriseApiKey，然后刷新浏览器。

inputs.output_count.tooltip.en: How many images to generate (1-4). Each image is charged separately.
inputs.output_count.tooltip.zh: 生成图片的数量（1～4）。每张图片单独计费。

inputs.suite_style_id.tooltip.en: Which suite style to generate. Fetched from your Bomi account. An empty list means the pack could not reach the API: set enterpriseApiKey in config.json, then refresh the browser.
inputs.suite_style_id.tooltip.zh: 选择要生成的套图风格。列表来自你的 Bomi 账号。若为空说明未能访问接口：请在 config.json 中填写 enterpriseApiKey，然后刷新浏览器。

inputs.model_count.tooltip.en: How many model images to generate (1-4).

inputs.background_count.tooltip.en: How many background images to generate (1-4).

inputs.model_ratio.tooltip.en: Aspect ratio of the model images.

inputs.background_ratio.tooltip.en: Aspect ratio of the background images.

inputs.jewelry_type_code.tooltip.en: What kind of jewelry the input image shows.
inputs.jewelry_type_code.tooltip.zh: 输入图片中的首饰类型。

inputs.lens_type_code.tooltip.en: Full photograph or a close-up of the jewelry.
inputs.lens_type_code.tooltip.zh: 整体摄影或首饰局部特写。

inputs.model_extra_prompt.tooltip.en: Extra wording about the model, on top of the chosen style. Optional, maximum 800 characters.
inputs.model_extra_prompt.tooltip.zh: 在所选风格之外对模特的补充描述。可选，最多 800 字符。

inputs.background_extra_prompt.tooltip.en: Extra wording about the background scene, on top of the chosen style. Optional, maximum 600 characters.
inputs.background_extra_prompt.tooltip.zh: 在所选风格之外对背景场景的补充描述。可选，最多 600 字符。

inputs.model_option_code.tooltip.en: Which material preset to process the image with.
inputs.model_option_code.tooltip.zh: 按所选品类预设处理图片。

inputs.category_option_id.tooltip.en: Required. Fetched from your Bomi account. An empty list means the pack could not reach the API: set enterpriseApiKey in config.json, then refresh the browser.
inputs.category_option_id.tooltip.zh: 必选。列表来自你的 Bomi 账号。若为空说明未能访问接口：请在 config.json 中填写 enterpriseApiKey，然后刷新浏览器。

inputs.ethnicity_option_id.tooltip.en: Leave on “not set” to let the API choose. Fetched from your Bomi account. An empty list means the pack could not reach the API: set enterpriseApiKey in config.json, then refresh the browser.
inputs.ethnicity_option_id.tooltip.zh: 保留“不指定”则由接口决定。列表来自你的 Bomi 账号。若为空说明未能访问接口：请在 config.json 中填写 enterpriseApiKey，然后刷新浏览器。

inputs.gender_option_id.tooltip.en: Leave on “not set” to let the API choose. Fetched from your Bomi account. An empty list means the pack could not reach the API: set enterpriseApiKey in config.json, then refresh the browser.
inputs.gender_option_id.tooltip.zh: 保留“不指定”则由接口决定。列表来自你的 Bomi 账号。若为空说明未能访问接口：请在 config.json 中填写 enterpriseApiKey，然后刷新浏览器。

inputs.angle_option_id.tooltip.en: Leave on “not set” to let the API choose. Fetched from your Bomi account. An empty list means the pack could not reach the API: set enterpriseApiKey in config.json, then refresh the browser.
inputs.angle_option_id.tooltip.zh: 保留“不指定”则由接口决定。列表来自你的 Bomi 账号。若为空说明未能访问接口：请在 config.json 中填写 enterpriseApiKey，然后刷新浏览器。

inputs.extra_prompt.tooltip.en: Extra wording on top of the options above. Optional, maximum 800 characters.
inputs.extra_prompt.tooltip.zh: 在以上选项之外的补充描述。可选，最多 800 字符。

inputs.seed.tooltip.en: Not sent to the API. It exists only to change this node's cache key: ComfyUI reuses a cached result when nothing changed, so without a new seed a second Run would not call Bomi at all. By default the value randomizes after every Run, which means every Run is a new billed job - set the control below it to 'fixed', or set seedControlAfterGenerate to false in config.json, to keep repeat Runs free.
inputs.seed.tooltip.zh: 不会发送给接口。它的唯一作用是改变本节点的缓存键：输入没有变化时 ComfyUI 会直接复用缓存结果，因此若不更换种子，再次运行根本不会调用 Bomi。默认每次运行后该值会随机变化，也就是每次运行都是一次新的计费任务——如需重复运行不计费，可将其下方的控制项设为 fixed，或在 config.json 中把 seedControlAfterGenerate 设为 false。

errors.10005.zh: API Key 无效或已停用

errors.10009.en: Task does not exist or access denied
errors.10009.zh: Task 不存在或无权访问

errors.32001.en: Feature not enabled for the enterprise

errors.32002.zh: 企业账号或套餐不可用

errors.32004.en: Duplicate request ID with different request content
errors.32004.zh: 相同请求 ID 对应不同请求内容

errors.32006.en: Request currently processing; cannot retry yet
errors.32006.zh: 相同请求正在处理，暂不能重放

errors.missingApiKey.en: No API Key configured. Set enterpriseApiKey in config.json, set the BOMI_ENTERPRISE_API_KEY environment variable, or fill the api_key input.
errors.missingApiKey.zh: 未配置 API Key。请在 config.json 中设置 enterpriseApiKey，或设置 BOMI_ENTERPRISE_API_KEY 环境变量，或填写节点的 api_key 输入。

errors.network.en: Cannot reach the Bomi API at {url}: {reason}
errors.network.zh: 无法访问 Bomi 接口 {url}：{reason}

errors.httpStatus.zh: Bomi 接口 {path} 返回 HTTP {status}

errors.badJson.en: Bomi API returned a non-JSON response for {path}
errors.badJson.zh: Bomi 接口 {path} 返回了非 JSON 响应

errors.createFailed.en: Task creation failed: no task was accepted ({detail})
errors.createFailed.zh: 任务创建失败：没有任务被接受（{detail}）

errors.timeout.en: Timed out after {seconds}s waiting for tasks {task_ids}. The tasks may still finish; look them up by task ID.
errors.timeout.zh: 等待任务 {task_ids} 超过 {seconds} 秒仍未完成。任务可能仍在处理中，可凭 task ID 查询。

errors.noImages.en: Task completed but returned no images for {item_code}
errors.noImages.zh: 任务已完成，但 {item_code} 没有返回图片

errors.validation.promptTooLong.zh: {field} 长度为 {length} 字符，最多允许 {maximum} 字符

errors.validation.countRange.en: {field} must be an integer from {minimum} to {maximum}, got {value}
errors.validation.countRange.zh: {field} 必须是 {minimum}～{maximum} 的整数，当前为 {value}

errors.validation.choice.zh: {field} 必须是 {choices} 之一，当前为 {value}

errors.validation.optionUnset.en: {field}: no option is selected. The dropdown is loaded from your Bomi account - set enterpriseApiKey in config.json, refresh the browser, then pick a value.
errors.validation.optionUnset.zh: {field}：未选择选项。下拉列表来自你的 Bomi 账号——请在 config.json 中填写 enterpriseApiKey，刷新浏览器后重新选择。

errors.validation.optionUnknown.en: {field}: {value} is no longer one of the available options. Pick it again from the dropdown.
errors.validation.optionUnknown.zh: {field}：{value} 已不在可选列表中，请从下拉列表中重新选择。

errors.validation.imageEncode.en: Could not encode the input image: {reason}

errors.validation.imageTooLarge.en: The input image is {size} after encoding ({width}x{height}), over the {maximum} upload limit. Reduce its resolution and try again.
errors.validation.imageTooLarge.zh: 输入图片编码后为 {size}（{width}×{height}），超过 {maximum} 的上传上限。请降低分辨率后重试。

errors.validation.imageFormat.en: Unsupported upload format {mime}; the API accepts only PNG and JPEG
errors.validation.imageFormat.zh: 不支持的上传格式 {mime}；接口仅支持 PNG 与 JPEG
